title: Match Rate Is Not Match Quality
abstract: arXiv:2611.23851v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Third-party identity-resolution vendors commonly emphasize match rate, the share of submitted records they can link to identifiers for advertising activation, as their core metric of quality. Yet a high match rate does not necessarily mean that those matched identifiers belong to the submitted records (i.e., the intended targets). In this paper we explore match quality as an alternative metric to match rate, utilizing a unique data set to evaluate match quality. We are able to compare two demographics, age and gender, from a submitted record (voter files) to the same demographics in self-reported surveys matched to mobile advertising identifiers linked together by two leading identity-resolution vendors. The data and matching was from 2019-20.   There is substantial ambiguity in match quality of the returned records. First, both vendors' activation files contain multiple device identifiers per match. translated_title: 匹配率并不等于匹配质量
translated_abstract: 第三方身份解析服务商通常将匹配率（即其能够关联到用于广告投放的标识符的提交记录所占比例）作为衡量其服务质量的核心指标加以强调。然而，高匹配率并不一定意味着这些匹配到的标识符确实属于提交的记录（即预期的目标对象）。本文利用一个独特的数据集，将匹配质量作为匹配率的替代指标进行探索与评估。我们能够将提交记录（选民档案）中的年龄和性别这两个人口统计特征，与两家领先的身份解析服务商所关联的移动广告标识符匹配到的自我报告调查中的相同人口统计特征进行比较。数据和匹配工作来自2019-20年。返回记录的匹配质量存在很大的模糊性。首先，两家服务商的激活文件中每次匹配都包含多个设备标识符。其次，经审计的样本中的匹配质量……
tldr: 本文指出第三方身份解析服务商常用的“匹配率”指标并不等同于“匹配质量”，并利用选民档案与自我报告调查中年龄、性别等人口统计数据的对比，评估发现高匹配率无法保证匹配到的标识符真正属于目标记录，且存在每次匹配对应多个设备标识符等模糊性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that the match rate emphasized by third-party identity-resolution vendors is not equal to match quality, and evaluates match quality by comparing demographics (age and gender) from voter files with self-reported surveys, finding that a high match rate does not guarantee matched identifiers belong to the intended targets, with substantial ambiguity such as multiple device identifiers per match.
